concerns.text: FR-001 (visual layout latents) is not covered by any task. All tasks generate deterministic structural latents (T003, T004, T005) and never invoke a frozen visual encoder.
FR-002 (train DistilledModel to predict visual layout latents) has no matching task. T005 trains a student to predict structural latents, not visual latents.
FR-004 (augmented representation with visual latents) is unmet. T007 concatenates predicted structural latents, not visual latents.
FR-007 (graceful failure on insufficient layout annotations) is not addressed. Tasks only check a minimum row count (T001/T002) but never verify presence of layout annotations.
SC-006 (count of documents with valid layout annotations) cannot be measured because no task validates or records layout‑annotation counts.
